incident.description: Reason: Snow forecast lowering down to 300m during Thursday and into the evening.. NOTE: Vehicle access is subject to weather, road conditions and parking capacity. Pinnacle Road on Kunanyi/Mt Wellington is closed at Park Entry (Gate 1 - Bracken Lane – 470 m asl) due to forecast snow from now through to Friday morning. Do not park on Pillinger Drive below Gate 1. Expect heavy congestion. Try Fern Tree. Snow and ice on the road will limit access to the mountain on Thursday, Friday and over the weekend. Next update: 24/07/2026 9:30:00 AM.
